entries.description: useradd hands out no subordinate id range any more, a manual one included: handing one out sorts /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid, and a docker customer's id mapping lives in their order. login.defs gets SUB_UID_COUNT and SUB_GID_COUNT 0

A docker customer whose subordinate ids an earlier useradd sorted gets them back in order, so container 1000 is the customer again and the customer reaches the own daemon socket. A daemon already running on the wrong map is restarted through h-add-user-docker, its containers come back by their restart policy
